generation_guards: Depict exactly one zebra and exactly one monkey.
Bind the white attribute only to the zebra.
Bind the wooden material attribute only to the monkey.
Keep both objects clearly visible and separated so they are not merged or occluding each other.
Do not add extra zebras or extra monkeys.

Do not include any additional zebras or monkeys.
